questions.questionText: The area included between the curves $y = x^3$ and $y = 4x^2$ is:

explanation.summary: Points of intersection: $x^3 = 4x^2 \implies x^2(x-4) = 0 \implies x=0, 4$. Area = $\int_0^4 (4x^2 - x^3) dx = [\frac{4x^3}{3} - \frac{x^4}{4}]_0^4 = \frac{256}{3} - 64 = \frac{64}{3}$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution

questions.questionText: A bag contains 5 red and 3 white marbles and another bag contains 2 red and 6 white marbles. 2 marbles are drawn at random from each bag. What is the probability that the marbles drawn are of the same colour?

explanation.summary: Both red from both bags: $\frac{\binom{5}{2}}{\binom{8}{2}} \times \frac{\binom{2}{2}}{\binom{8}{2}} = \frac{10}{28} \times \frac{1}{28} = \frac{10}{784}$. Both white from both bags: $\frac{\binom{3}{2}}{\binom{8}{2}} \times \frac{\binom{6}{2}}{\binom{8}{2}} = \frac{3}{28} \times \frac{15}{28} = \frac{45}{784}$. Total probability = $\frac{10 + 45}{784} = \frac{55}{784}$.

Both white from both bags: $\frac{\binom{3}{2}}{\binom{8}{2}} \times \frac{\binom{6}{2}}{\binom{8}{2}} = \frac{3}{28} \times \frac{15}{28} = \frac{45}{784}$. explanation.summary: $P(A)P(B) = 1/8$ and $(1-P(A))(1-P(B)) = 3/8 \implies 1 - (P(A)+P(B)) + 1/8 = 3/8 \implies P(A)+P(B) = 3/4$. Quadratic gives $1/2$ and $1/4$. Since $P(A) > P(B)$, $P(B) = 1/4$.

Displacement $\vec{d} = (5-1)\hat{i} + (4-2)\hat{j} + (1-3)\hat{k} = 4\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}$. Work done $W = \vec{F} \cdot \vec{d} = 7(4) + 2(2) + (-4)(-2) = 28 + 4 + 8 = 40$.

stepByStep.title: Official Solution
